question: Who among the following wrote the novel ‘Gora’?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Rabindranath Tagore**__.

__
 
• **The novel 'Gora' by Rabindra Nath Tagore is a novel epic of the national consciousness of India under British rule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Premchand:**

 
 
• He was born in a Kayastha family in Lamhi village of** Varanasi district (Uttar Pradesh).**
 
• His early education was done in** 'Persian'.**
 
• **Premchand's compositions -**
 
 
• His famous novels are **'Seva Sadan', 'Nirmala', 'Rangbhoomi', 'Karmabhoomi', 'Gaban', 'Godan'** etc.
 
• His huge collection of stories is published in **eight parts **under the name **'Mansarovar'.**​
 
 
 
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi:**
 
 
• **​**He is known as the **'Father of India'.**
 
• His full name is **Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi**.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi has made a special contribution in getting freedom from the British.
 
• **Champaran Satyagraha, Non-Cooperation Movement, Dandi Satyagraha,** **Dalit Movement, Quit India Movement **are some of his major movements.
 
 
 
• **Abanindranath Tagore:**
 
 
• He infused the **spirit of Swadeshi** in his paintings.
 
• He was the** chief painter and founder **of the** 'Indian Society of Oriental Art'.**
